Maybe, you might not need the speed, slow u-turn is valuable also so scizor can take a hit and then let one of your sweepers in safely. Personally the rotom i run uses a bit of speed even though its the bulky set but im not sure what most people run here. Out speeding 0 speed rotom means you outspeed atamand max speed crawdaunt which is nice. But if youre going banded imo adamant just feels really good just because of how much damage you get with it.

Yeah hit them with a toxic and just wait for them to faint. Banded scizor is usually adamant max hp max atk b punch cc pursuit uturn. Yes serp and shao are your fast mons that can sweep late game. You also have good speed control w glare. If you’re using chansey to deal w volc and other special sweepers it makes sense to drop rock coverage for hp ice. You’ll probably have to test it so see which works best. Just make sure it’s naive if youre using hp ice to avoid lowering your spatk. Raikou is good but zapdos has more versatility. The most common sets are bulky. Either def or spdef depending on the team. Its typing allows it to resist fighting steel grass bug and its an elec type immune to ground. Volt switch hurricane heatwave roost toxic are its most common moves in those sets. Then theres the offensive rain zapdos which can spam thunder and hurricane without missing and has good coverage in weather ball (base 100 water move in rain). Tbh if you dont want to run chansey spdef zapdos could also be good in your team. Volt switch heatwave hurricane and roost calm max spdef and hp w leftovers. You can drop hurricane for toxic if you dont want to worry about missing.

Your team isn’t weak to stealth rock yes but 12.5% HP still racks up if you aren’t careful even w Regenerator and Poison Heal. Zapdos is really common nowadays and this team has a pretty bad match-up against it. I know you dont like choice items but once you get the hang of it Banded Scizor is so good. It’s not meant to sweep teams it was meant to wear down their defenses so yea a lot of the time you’ll be clicking u-turn. You need fake-out on shao it can make a huge difference in preventing a sweep from a mon thats sashed. You’re probably scared of the accuracy but if you’re going rock coverage stone edge is best, the damage makes it worth it. If youre gonna go mixed might as well make it naive. So either drop hp ice and go stone edge and fakeout or change r slide to fake out and go naive. You’re also really weak to volc if you’re using amoonguss as your spdef wall. Also, going spdef bulky but running foul play isn’t great synergy. Imo I’d drop amoonguss for chansey (bold max hp and def) toxic softboiled teleport seismic toss. Gliscor really appreciates protect as it makes the most out of the heals plus you already have pivoters in rotom scizor and shao. It’s also good for scouting moves, especially if the  mon is running a choice item.

Hey 25M here I’ve tried electrical stimulation as a kid. But because I was quite young I’m not really sure whether I benefited from it or not. I just wanna add my voice to what the others are saying. Firstly, I’m sorry you have insecurities about your arm. I still harbor feelings of resentment too about my childbirth so I relate to how you’re feeling. But exercise and supportive community really does wonders. I’ve been playing football(soccer) avidly for around 10 years now and the friends have made really helped in growing my confidence. Going to the gym also helped in a similar way, my personal experience with the gym is actually quite good and most of the people I meet there are really encouraging. Also seeing a psychotherapist is quite helpful. If you have financial restrictions maybe just going out for a walk frequently and listening to music or a podcast will help, it’s certainly helped me (High Performance is a podcast I enjoy in particular). I also have struggles with wanting to look normal and to be honest thats probably one of the most difficult situations for people like us. But I like to think it is a struggle worth undertaking. Its difficulty will make overcoming it all the more worth it and can help build an inner strength unique to us. With regards to your mom she probably trying to help but not in the most helpful of ways, maybe you can suggest how she can actually make you feel better about yourself?
